articles.title: Lost or Stolen Card
articles.content: If your Visa card is lost or stolen: Call Visa India at 000-800-100-1219 immediately. From anywhere else, call Visa's Global Customer Assistance Service at +1 303 967 1090 (24/7). Your card can be blocked within 30 minutes of reporting. Emergency cash and replacement cards can be arranged.

articles.title: Travellers Cheques
articles.content: For lost or stolen Visa Travellers Cheques: Call the issuer immediately (check your purchase receipt for the number). Have ready: cheque serial numbers, purchase date/location, details of loss. Refunds are typically processed within 24 hours. Report to local police as well.
